arm_groups.label: Pembrolizumab + Chemotherapy
arm_groups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab every 3 weeks (Q3W) + paclitaxel weekly + carboplatin (weekly or Q3W) x 4 cycles, followed by pembrolizumab Q3W + (doxorubicin OR epirubicin) + cyclophosphamide Q3W x 4 cycles as neoadjuvant therapy prior to surgery; followed by 9 cycles of pembrolizumab Q3W as adjuvant therapy post-surgery.
